units.source_en: A thin film of ice covered the surface of the pool beneath the weirwood.
Theon sank to his knees beside it.
“Please,” he murmured through his broken teeth, “I never meant …” The words caught in his throat.
“Save me,” he finally managed.
“Give me …”
What?
Strength?
Courage?
Mercy?

paragraphs.source_en: Snow fell around him, pale and silent, keeping its own counsel. The only sound was a faint soft sobbing.

Jeyne, he thought.

paragraphs.source_en: It is her, sobbing in her bridal bed. Who else could it be?
